permissionAndConcurrencyChecks: Student MOBILE-only routes and strict count/type/query/body bounds; generic practice, teacher and bank management routes remain denied
Unsubmitted top-level and composite child answers/explanations are absent; first own submission alone reveals reference and feedback
Web and native operations share practice advisory transactions with fresh session, current role, learning permission, course access and organization practice flag checked after the lock
Mobile create UUID plus canonical request hash and unique per-user nullable index create exactly one session under concurrent/retried requests; changing conditions under the same key rejects
Repeated first-answer requests retain the first value and update mistake count once; six types keep subjective answers outside objective accuracy
Real committed create/answer response loss is recovered with fixed create identity or read-only answer receipt, without duplicate records
Practice position/flags share website revision; stale writes reject409 and native requires explicit reload without silently discarding current input
Current inactive/closed practice questions withhold body, answers and references in mobile snapshots and reject new answers
Real Chrome verifies native session position and completed report using existing website UI
Real PostgreSQL queued enrollment, organization practice flag and device session revocations prevent writes; single-connection transaction avoids nested authentication pool acquisition

Native Android verifies course configuration, six-type snapshot, absent references, unsaved leave and answer-confirmation cancel, first feedback, flags, restart/history resume, web revision conflict, all-type completion/report and feature withdrawal
All prior native course media/files, planner, assignments, exams, reviews, notes, notifications, WebRTC and session journeys rerun

resolvedDuringAcceptance: First remote CI passed1463/1465 but WebKit missed the ended heading while media was already closed. Shared Query polling intentionally suspends in background tabs. The browser test now independently verifies server ENDED and the teacher ended page, then brings the student page to the foreground before the unchanged student ended/disabled assertions; it neither forces reload nor overrides query state, and records actual page visibility on failure. Default full acceptance reran after this harness-only change.

A final driver diagnosis found coordinate overscroll could trigger pull-to-refresh and clear the expected draft-conflict message. Long-page traversal now uses actual native accessibility scroll actions, without touch overscroll or simulated state, while retaining stable-bound single taps and every original business assertion
After host restart, real review PostgreSQL was unavailable; restarted the existing isolated cluster without resetting data before rerunning Android validation

A subsequent full Android run missed the unpublished assignment feedback button during layout movement; the driver now requires stable real accessibility bounds before issuing one tap, with an additional full assignment journey and complete Android rerun

Full Android regression initially stopped at the expected practice leave-confirmation dialog after feature withdrawal; the harness now explicitly confirms leaving and verifies the home page before the remaining exam/live journeys

Dedicated real API six-type retry assertion initially compared arrays by reference; corrected to deep equality so actual array/object answer preservation is verified, then all nine real API/browser checks rerun

Existing practice operations checked authorization before a transaction lock; shared web/native service now refreshes current authorization after locking and removes nested pool acquisitions; dedicated queued-revocation and single-connection tests pass
